'''Dalan Reid''' was a veteran [[identity slicer]]. Reid spent twelve [[Standard year/Legends|years]] in isolation due to the high illegality of his job, developing personality quirks that eventually led to [[Brain/Legends|mental]] imbalance. Afterward, using local wildlife, he began constructing replicas of [[Viella Zall]], a [[Musician/Legends|singer]] on the [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]]<ref name="Slicers" /> [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Communications grid/Legends|communications grid]].<ref name="Encyclopedia">{{CSWECite|II|52|Holonet}}</ref> Having made dozens of replicas, Reid used them for an impromptu [[Music/Legends|concert]] on<ref name="Slicers" /> the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], where he was [[Prisoner/Legends|caught]]<ref name="Slicers" /> by [[3630 BBY]].<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|4.3}} Since the Identity Slicers Codex entry, which mentions Dalan Reid, was added with Game Update 4.3, it can be placed in that same [[Standard year/Legends|year]], as well.</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Dalan Reid was mentioned in the Codex entry for Identity Slicers in the [[2015]] expansion [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire|''Knights of the Fallen Empire'']] to the [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', which was released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]].<ref name="Slicers" />
